answer: A simple way to resist sybil attacks is to make new agents earn trust slowly, like a sonnet takes patience to compose. Each agent must stake a small deposit and gather attestations from established peers before its votes count. An agent in a velvet meadow of fake identities still stands out: costly proof-of-work on account creation means flooding the network with puppets costs real money. Recurring contribution checks then prune dormant duplicates, so reputation grows only through sustained, verifiable work rather than cheap cloning.
